dsh-client-ui-skins is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b65474c07b8f59884715.html
